faq_heading: Richmond condos under $600,000: your questions answered

faq.q: How many Richmond condos sell for under $600,000?
faq.a: 294 of 1,218, or 24%. A further 675 sold in the next range up, $600,000 to $799,999.

faq.q: What is the median price of a condo in Richmond?
faq.a: $598,000 from November 1, 2025 to October 31, 2026, so $600,000 is above the middle of the market. The middle half sold between $500,000 and $725,000.

faq.q: Which Richmond area has the lowest condo prices?
faq.a: Granville, at $186,500 across 8 sales at $225 a square foot, median year built 1974. The highest of the 10 lowest was Broadmoor at $601,800.

faq.q: How fast do Richmond condos sell?
faq.a: 30 days at the median, closing at 96.5% of the last list price, with 6% above list.

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Figures are Paragon closed and pending sales to October 31, 2026. A pending sale is firm but has not completed, so its price can still change. A median is shown only where at least 5 homes sold. The live search is not connected yet (Jerry’s saved search, price filter $600,000).

In Richmond, 294 of the 1,218 condos (24%) sold under $600,000. The median was $598,000, with the middle half between $500,000 and $725,000. The busiest price range, $600,000 to $799,999, had 675 sales.

blocks.text: Buying a condo under $600,000 in Richmond

In Granville the median condo sold for $186,500 across 8 sales, $413,500 under $600,000. Across Richmond the median condo took 30 days to sell and closed at 96.5% of the last list price, with 6% of the 1,218 sales above list. Check the strata fee and depreciation report.
